notes.title: We brought all chapters together into one game & part 3 is out! :D
notes.content:
Dear friends :) I'm glad to announce that we finalized the major update of Invisible Apartment 1 which we were working on for a long time. You're now able to play part 0, 1, 2 and the new part 3 from within the same game as DLCs.

If you already purchased Invisible Apartment Zero as a separate game than we'll give you the keys for the new DLC for free - just follow the guide at http://steamcommunity.com/app/351790/discussions/0/348293292497416125/

http://store.steampowered.com/app/543220/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/532060/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/543230/

We also have a bundle which is really affordable at http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/1766/

notes.title: Invisible Apartment 3 Kickstarter relaunch!
notes.content:
Dear friends :) After Months of production we now relaunched the crowdfunding campaign for the third part of the series. We figured that we rushed the Kickstarter for part 3 last year, so we took some time to bring you more content and to have the VN mostly complete. The current campaign's goal is to make enough money for editing and finalizing the production. 

Please help us finalize the Invisible Apartment visual novel series :) 

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/vysoko/invisible-apartment-3

notes.title: Linux & Mac fix
notes.content:
If you purchased Invisible Apartment Zero for Linux or Mac and Steam only downloaded 0 bytes, then please do the following:

1. in your games library click "Delete Local Content" from the menu that appears if you right click
2. restart Steam client
3. click Install from the game's screen

Sorry for the inconvenience :) 

The downloading of content should work normally if you purchased the game after this announcement.
